scope: Actual runtime handlers exercised in isolated Unity Play mode. Bounded rewards, real physical pickup contact, callback idempotence, production simulation timers, pause/retry/mode isolation, pooled visual correctness, warmed allocations and actual guide UI raycast/textfit at three portrait sizes. 30/60/120 Hz are simulated correctness samples; visual appearance and device performance remain unverified.
